title: 第25章 入圣地遗迹寻宝第26章 上三境天寿丹
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【“至于最后一方势力，虽然前几年是有西域邪魔进入境内，但早已被国内武者找到处决掉了。
此次进入遗迹威胁是不大的，只是收获多少罢了，我们需要对付的便只有遗迹内的生物，如果对手强大，我们大可遁走，在遗迹外围进行寻找即可。”
【“再说了，他人可能不清楚枫儿你的实力，我还不清楚吗，不敢说你能力敌凝神境强者，就单说虚神境内，我想很难找到能与你一战的人了，我们此次说不定会有不错的收获。”
【听到江长天分析的头头是道，你略微沉吟，最后还是决定跟他一起前往圣地遗迹内探索试一试，毕竟遗迹内的东西你也很是心动，如果真能获得天级的宝材，你的修为进境还能进步一大截。
【毕竟在江国，地级的宝材也许还能通过天炎金币进行兑换，购买。
但天级的宝材已经是可遇不可求的了，各方势力都不会嫌弃自家的天级宝物多，即使能收到，那也是以物换物。
而现在你身上最值钱的物件，也只有当初在传承秘境内的那柄地级上品的宝器了。
【这一次前往圣地遗迹内，说不定能给你增加一些底蕴，这种机会确实可遇不可求，下次估计就很难碰上这样的机遇。
【随后，你与江长天走出了雪山派驻地，向着此前感知到的地方飞去，在飞往目的地的途中，你感知到了好几股势力，其中有你熟悉的宜城城主，柳家老祖，闵家老祖，但更多的是其他地方，此前没有交过手的大能。
【在你感知到他们气息的时候，他们也察觉到了你，但并没有阻止你的打算。
而与你相识的柳家老祖在察觉到你的时候，脸上顿时有些阴沉，他能明确感受到，你又变强了。
【不到短短一百年的时间，你居然再次进境，这样的修炼速度让柳元尽有些胆寒。
只是对此他也无可奈何，因为立了武道誓言的缘故，如今他已经无法对你出手，再则他也不是你的对手，你变的更强也还是打不过你，对于他来说局势似乎并没有什么变化。
【想到这里，柳元尽有些释怀，好在与你没有深仇大恨，不至于在你成长起来后将柳家灭族。
【另一侧的闵家老祖则不同，毕竟上次他们是主动想要抢夺你的红铜矿脉，已然算是结下了不小的仇恨，好在并没有伤到人，并且事后有送了赔礼。
但是当时闵家并没有真的太将你放在眼里，在他们看来大不了以后类似的资源他们不争夺，你也不至于前往萍城霸占他们的资源，毕竟闵家与柳家不同，与你不在一个竞争赛道。
【但如今看来，进境惊人的你，是真有可能突破到凝神境，届时即使他们身处于萍城，他们也不会感觉安全。
就这样前往遗迹的途中，闵家老祖两人一直在思考着对策。
【对于柳闵两家在关注你的事情，你并不清楚，不过即使你知道对此也不会在意，败在你手中之敌，从来不会被你视为对手，你给他们时间追赶，也只能看到你的背影。
content_en:
[“As for the last force, although there were demons from the Western Regions who entered the territory in the past few years, they had already been found and executed by domestic warriors.
The threat of entering the ruins this time is not great, it just depends on how much we gain. The only creatures we need to deal with are the creatures in the ruins. If the opponent is strong, we can escape and search outside the ruins. "
["Besides, others may not know your strength Feng'er. I don't know either. I dare not say that your ability is comparable to those in the Ningshen Realm. Just speaking of the Void God Realm, I think it will be difficult to find someone who can fight with you. We may have a good harvest this time."
[Hearing Jiang Changtian’s lucid analysis, you pondered for a moment, and finally decided to go with him to explore the ruins of the Holy Land to give it a try. After all, you are also very excited about the things in the ruins. If you can really obtain heaven-level treasures, your cultivation level will be improved a lot.
[After all, in Jiang State, prefecture-level treasures may be exchanged and purchased with Tianyan gold coins.
But heaven-level treasures are hard to come by, and all forces will not disdain that they have many heaven-level treasures. Even if they can receive them, it will be in exchange for things.
And now the most valuable object on your body is the earth-level high-grade treasure that was in the secret realm of inheritance.
[Going to the ruins of the Holy Land this time may be able to add some knowledge to you. This kind of opportunity is indeed rare. It is estimated that it will be difficult to encounter such an opportunity next time.
[Subsequently, you and Jiang Changtian walked out of the Snow Mountain Station and flew towards the place you had sensed before. On the way to the destination, you sensed several forces, including the Yicheng City Lord, the ancestor of the Liu family, and the ancestor of the Min family that you are familiar with, but there were more powerful people from other places who had never fought against each other before.
[When you sensed their aura, they also sensed you, but had no intention of stopping you.
When the Liu family ancestor who met you noticed you, his face suddenly became gloomy. He could clearly feel that you had become stronger again.
[In less than a hundred years, you actually entered the country again. This speed of cultivation makes Liu Yuanjin a little scared.
It's just that he has nothing to do about it. Because of the martial arts oath, he can no longer attack you. Besides, he is not your opponent. Even if you become stronger, he still can't beat you. For him, the situation does not seem to have changed.
[Thinking of this, Liu Yuanjin feels a little relieved. Fortunately, he doesn’t have any deep hatred against you, so he won’t wipe out the Liu family when you grow up.
[The ancestors of the Min family on the other side are different. After all, they took the initiative to rob you of the red copper veins last time, and they have already developed a lot of hatred. Fortunately, no one was hurt, and they sent an apology afterwards.
But the Min family didn't really pay much attention to you at that time. In their opinion, the big deal was that they wouldn't compete for similar resources in the future, and you wouldn't go to Pingcheng to seize their resources. After all, the Min family was different from the Liu family and was not on the same competitive track as you.
[But now it seems that it is really possible for you, who has made an astonishing progress, to break through to the Concentration Realm. Even if they are in Pingcheng, they will not feel safe.
On the way to the ruins, the two ancestors of the Min family kept thinking about countermeasures.
[You don’t know that the Liu and Min families are paying attention to you, but even if you know it, you won’t care. The enemy who is defeated by you will never be regarded as your opponent. If you give them time to catch up, they can only see your back.
title_en: Chapter 25 Entering the Holy Land Ruins to Hunt for Treasures Chapter 26 The Heavenly Shou Dan of the Three Upper Realms
